name: Chicken and sweet potato hash
description: A hearty one-skillet breakfast of sweet potato, onion, and red bell pepper cooked in olive oil and finished with chili powder and seared chicken breast.
instructions: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into small cubes, then dice the onion and the bell pepper.
Warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add the sweet potato in a single layer, and cook undisturbed for 8 minutes.
Stir in the onion and the bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes more, until they soften.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces, toss them with the chili powder, and add them to the skillet.
Cook, stirring every few minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sweet potato is tender, about 12 minutes.
Divide the hash between two bowls and serve warm.
